verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents its own soundbite creation through the MCP tool fireflies_create_soundbite, which makes a soundbite clip from a meeting transcript. However, the evidence only covers this as an MCP/AI-tool action, and the documented sharing (fireflies_share_meeting) shares whole meeting transcripts rather than an individual clip. Missing for 10: documented sharing of a soundbite or highlight clip on its own, an in-app user-facing clip-cutting workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording

citations.quote: fireflies_create_soundbite - Create a soundbite clip from a meeting transcript
